root_cause: MCP registry policy check fails 401: 'Failed to fetch MCP registry policy: 401. Non-default MCP servers will be blocked until the policy can be fetched.'
technical_detail: The copilot CLI runs with COPILOT_TOKEN=placeholder-token-for-credential-isolation (AWF credential isolation). The MCP registry check at api.github.com/copilot/mcp_registry fails 401. Both 'github' and 'safeoutputs' MCP servers are filtered out.
log_evidence: 2026-04-28T01:25:37.648Z [ERROR] MCP server 'safeoutputs' filtered: Could not verify server against any configured registry
impact: Agent cannot push branches or create/update PRs/issues/comments. All runs fail with 'No Safe Outputs Generated'.
fix_needed: Ensure the Copilot token provided to the agentic workflow has access to verify the safeoutputs MCP server against the Copilot MCP registry, OR configure the safeoutputs server as a default/built-in MCP that doesn't require registry verification.
